Question
========
Explain the following concept, spelling out the acronym first if there is one. Give its definition and its usage, and if it has several usages, its most important one.

**IOMMU**

Solution
========
Input Output Memory Management Unit. It translates and checks the addresses used by devices doing DMA. Its most important use is isolation: it prevents a device, or a driver in a virtual machine, from reading or writing arbitrary host memory.
